annotationBasis: Independent Codex visual review of source photographs only, before new candidate implementation/results were inspected by this evaluator. Not human-adjudicated physical ground truth.
limits: Approximate visible bounds, not instance segmentation masks.
Basin shape describes the visible bowl/outer ceramic form at source resolution; ambiguous cases are unknown.
Install wall is a source-view wall label, not surveyed room orientation.
Unknown values are excluded from attribute denominators; no measured mm or full camera truth exists.
Continuous double-basin vanity counts as one fixture assembly with basinCount=2.
Reflections are separate observations, never physical fixtures.
License declarations reviewed from Commons metadata; no product-photo ownership inference.

selection.method: Coverage-based source-only selection, then deterministic group SHA256 split; related Mid-City views forced into development to avoid group leakage.

excluded.reason: Found historical photo album; original photographer unknown despite Flickr CC BY label. Replaced before evaluation freeze with own-work Bergen bathroom photograph.

selection.privateUserPhotos: Supplemental local regression only, outside this licensed corpus; never redistributed.
selection.syntheticPhotos: Excluded from real-photo corpus; existing generated demo may remain a separate rendering regression.

metricPolicy.boundsFormat: normalized [left, top, right, bottom] after orientation
metricPolicy.matching: maximum-total-IoU one-to-one class-agnostic assignment, minimum IoU 0.25; high-uncertainty glass bounds excluded from localization score but presence/attributes still reviewed
metricPolicy.unknown: Do not coerce to a known label; abstentions reported separately.
metricPolicy.failures: Errors/invalid JSON/cancelled runs retained and reported separately; no successful-subset-only adoption claim.
metricPolicy.prohibited: No arbitrary composite accuracy; no manual edits counted as AI success; no photo-specific app rules.
